role: State environmental review agency, indirect source reviewing agency
stance_basis: DNR approved Air Quality Report and Notice of Intent, endorsing the project's air quality compliance
summary: The Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (DNR) served as the Indirect Source Review Agency for the Airport Spur project and reviewed the air quality assessment. DNR approved the Air Quality Report and Notice of Intent to Construct on November 20, 1975, pursuant to Wisconsin Administration Code NR 154.05, supporting the conclusion that the project would not violate National Ambient Air Quality Standards or significantly degrade air quality. DNR also indicated there would be no significant impact on fish or wildlife habitat in the project area.
